CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to a named content was found.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates) is paired with an explicit origin/status entry for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim tied to a named content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content-identification entries name colors and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: The report separates identified content entries from explicit origin/status metadata (e.g. completed_record, executed_branch_claim:false).

O.rationale: The text states presentation/layout rules and includes explicit origin/representation metadata describing how contents are presented/represented.
